simple.meaning: רַב (rab) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 461 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 6:5. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רַב (H7227).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: רַב (rab) / H7227 is traced through Genesis 6:5, Genesis 7:11, Genesis 13:6, Genesis 18:20 as a generated source-based concept entry.
